blocks.x: NOW YOU WEREN'T PLAYING ANY ARRANGEMENTS AT THIS TIME WITH NO ARRANGER IN THIS BAND.

EVERYBODY READ MUSIC IN THE BAND.

Everybody had to read music to join that band. Started to read from the beginning. And that's one thing he insisted upon and later when it got to be a co-op band, we all insisted anybody joining that band had to be a heck of a reader and an improvisor. He had to improvise.
